title: Oikonomou2016 – SSVEP MAMEM 1 dataset
description: A 256-channel EEG dataset from 11 healthy subjects performing a steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface task. Subjects attended to a single flickering visual stimulus at five frequencies (6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00, and 12.00 Hz) presented sequentially. The dataset comprises 1,104 trials acquired at 250 Hz sampling rate and is accompanied by a comprehensive comparative evaluation of signal processing algorithms and classifiers for SSVEP-based BCI applications.
methods_description: EEG signals were recorded using an EGI 300 Geodesic EEG System with a 256-channel GSN-HydroCel montage at 250 Hz sampling rate. Subjects focused attention on a single magenta flickering box presented on a 22-inch LCD monitor (60 Hz refresh rate, 1680×1080 resolution). Each frequency was presented for 5-second trials followed by 5-second rest periods, repeated 3 times per frequency with 30-second inter-frequency rest intervals. Data were acquired in raw, unpreprocessed format.
